results.title: Donbas Within Reach
results.overview: Dariia Kovalchuk travelled there from Prague with a friend. She remembers Donbas as a place where she spent carefree holidays and fell asleep beneath the stars. Now, however, she finds empty streets and houses scarred by Russian shelling.

results.title: Water Wears Away
results.overview: Time and water slowly wear away the stone of Kateryna’s faith in the future. Living as an emigrant in Prague, she returns to memories of a place where she felt at home: the years spent with her Ukrainian friends at the Sea of Azov. But the full-scale invasion of Ukraine continues to wash away everything she holds dear. Her hometown, Zaporizhzhia, lies close to the frontline, the family house by the sea of Azov is occupied, and the friends she grew up with have dispersed. These memories remain alive through hours of recordings from Kateryna’s personal video archive. Now, together with her friends in Prague, she tries to make sense of the unbearable weight of grief and loss one has to carry in the present. As she revisits her past, she also questions what to expect from the future, and how to keep the growing societal polarisation from occupying the space of friendship.

results.title: Outside/Inside
results.overview: From Ji-hlava film festival catalogue: For seven years, the director follows the life of Ceci, a stray cat that gradually settles into his home without ever completely leaving the world of the streets. Their ever-changing relationship forms the backbone of this time-lapse narrative, into which other cats and fragments of the director’s life are woven: unfinished film projects, relationships with neighbours, his deteriorating health, and events unfolding in the city and across the country.  (...)This intimate chronicle of an unusual friendship simultaneously records the passage of time and the transformations of a human life, which becomes ever more closely intertwined with that of the cat.  “The presence of the cat is central, but not as a character in a narrative sense. Rather, she becomes a point of departure, a way to move away from a human-centred perspective, without replacing it with another fixed position.” — Maani Petgar

results.title: Beware the Box Folk
results.overview: While pursuing a deadly political scandal in the midst of a garbage strike, a muckraking journalist uncovers a strange community of people who have escaped society by wearing cardboard boxes and hiding amongst the trash.

results.title: Anatomy of a Crash
results.overview: Jediná vteřina is a feature-length documentary by Vít Klusák about the fine line between everyday bad driving habits and a tragedy that cannot be undone. Using a mobile phone at the wheel, fatigue, rushing through a yellow light, or the feeling that we have everything under control. Bad habits behind the wheel that usually go unpunished. But what happens when they don’t? The film follows four stories of road accidents and the people involved, who must come to terms with the moment when the lives of so many were changed forever. Through intimate portraits, cinematic reconstructions and unusual encounters between the perpetrators and their victims or bereaved families, it explores responsibility, guilt and the possibility of forgiveness. The film reveals our ability to excuse our own failings and poses a disturbing question: what if we are less different from the people who caused the accidents than we would like to admit?

results.title: Kordell Stewart / Slash & Burn
results.overview: For a generation of football fans, former Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Kordell "Slash" Stewart was one of the most electrifying players of the 1990s. But just as he became one of football's biggest stars, a malicious rumor upended his life. Through candid interviews with Stewart and others who witnessed his brightest and darkest moments, explore the personal toll of scrutiny beyond the football field while searching for the truth behind a story that followed Stewart for decades.

results.title: I Dreamed of a Man Who Dreamed of Horses
results.original_title: Soñaba con un hombre que soñaba con caballos

results.title: Song Bird
results.overview: Coming up on the one year anniversary of her grandmother's passing, Taloa, a young, mixed-Choctaw woman, is still deep in the throes of grief. One night, a mysterious man steps in to help.

results.title: A Lost Art
results.overview: Two career criminals risk it all on one last job for their ruthless boss, but their fall guy might just be the death of them.

results.title: There's No Place Like Rome
results.overview: The Bulgarian uncle, in love with antiquity, guards old treasures and ideals of masculinity. Despising the modern age is his #RomanEmpire. The nephew drops by for a visit.

results.title: Light
results.overview: Summer 1995 in East Germany. Artists in the country, working, living, loving. A video treasure trove enables a portrait of painter Käthe Ebner to emerge from their midst.

results.title: Neighborhood Autobahn
results.overview: Who de nes borders and determines which side you are allowed to be on? A cinematic observation along the former Marienborn border checkpoint in Saxony-Anhalt.

results.title: Maro's Photo
results.overview: Children playing on the Panzerweise in Munich, a woman with angels’ wings. Mother and son return to the location of the black-and-white footage to reconstruct history and story alike.

results.title: The Core
results.overview: A woman falls ill. Normality ends. Standstill. Suddenly everything is too much: everyday life, filmmaking, responsibility. What is the essence of life?

results.title: Hi Mom :O
results.overview: The director’s footage and that of his mother flow together. Full of doll faces and flowers, her film archive throws up questions. She says, “Film your own reality!” Sounds great, but how?

results.title: Hello Debus
results.overview: A father makes requests on the answering machine of his son, who’s so paralysed he’s become a veritable still life. Overwhelmed, helpless; an absurd transformation begins.

results.title: My Brilliant Father
results.overview: The writer-father suffers from dementia and is losing his words. The daughter’s camera follows him. He likes to direct himself, she likes to direct him, too.

results.title: The Way We Look at Things
results.original_title: The Way We Look at Things
results.overview: Lines that turn into insects, an entire swarm, a landscape – before dissolving once again.
